notes: Product line consists of paired modules SO-SFP-1000BASE-BX20D-35 (Tx/Rx 1310/1550 nm) and SO-SFP-1000BASE-BX20D-53 (Tx/Rx 1550/1310 nm) on single SM fiber. Nominal wavelength Tx/Rx: 1310nm/1550nm and 1550nm/1310nm. Transmit wavelength ranges: 1270–1350 nm (footnote 1, -35) and 1520–1580 nm (footnote 2, -53). Receiver wavelength ranges: 1530–1570 nm (footnote 1) and 1260–1360 nm (footnote 2). Power budget 0–14 dB. Industrial option (-I): operating temperature -40°C to +85°C; storage temperature -40°C to +85°C for all. Transmitter output power and receiver min input power, overload are average power (footnote 3). Receiver minimum input power and overload measured @ 1.25 Gbps, BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹², PRBS 2⁷-1, back-to-back (footnote 4). Title states 1.063/1.25 Gbps and 14 dB, 20 km, C-temp & I-temp.
